title: Pope Francis message and Vatican paintings of orbs with angels

tellings.quote: and Pope Francis uh she said to tell me that they know that they're angels

plain: Pope Francis is said to have sent word that the Church knows the glowing orbs people report are angels, and the Vatican is said to hold paintings showing orbs alongside angels. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had many encounters with UFOs, tells this as a message passed to him by Diana Pasulka, a professor who studies religion: "she said to tell me that they know that they're angels." If true, it would mean the Vatican reads these lights in religious terms.
